name: Settlement Permit -- Gainful Employment Excluded (Private Means)

qualifying_event.description: For third-country nationals settling in Austria without taking up any gainful employment (e.g. financially independent individuals, pensioners), subject to an annual numeric quota.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of stable monthly funds; health insurance; accommodation; declaration of no gainful employment.

requirements.blocker_text: Stable monthly funds of at least EUR 2,616.78 (single, 2025 figure), EUR 4,128.24 for couples/registered partnerships, plus EUR 403.76 per child, without recourse to gainful employment.
Only a limited number of these permits are granted per year under Austria's settlement quota system, separate from merit or funds.

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, extendable to 3 years after completing Integration Agreement Module 1 and 2 years' lawful residence

sources.title: migration.gv.at -- Other forms of settlement: Settlement Permit -- Gainful Employment Excluded, 2025 monthly-funds figures, quota system, 1-year permit extendable to 3 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria). This is Austria's dedicated non-economic 'private means' settlement route -- analogous to Luxembourg's private_reasons_residence.json in this dataset -- distinct from every work/study/family/investor route since it explicitly excludes gainful employment. The quota requirement is a real structural constraint outside the applicant's control, modeled as a hard requirement to flag that meeting the funds test alone does not guarantee a grant in a given year.
